name: The One Naiharn
shortDescription: Completed hotel-managed condominium of 196 studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments in the Rawai and Nai Harn area, with a pool, kids club and gym.
description:
A single eight-storey building with 196 apartments on a site of about 4,480 sqm, recorded as completed in March 2026. Listed in Rawai, it is marketed under the Nai Harn name and is about 1.7 km from Rawai Beach.
Resale and developer units come as studios of around 27 sqm, one-bedroom apartments from about 30 to 69 sqm and a small number of two-bedroom units. Facilities include a communal pool, kids pool and kids club, sauna, gym, indoor kids zone, lobby and automated parking, with hotel-style management.
Unit counts vary between portals (196 to 218), so confirm availability with the seller. Foreign buyers can hold freehold within the quota; the project pays a freehold premium per the portal.

researchNotes: New project added 2026-11-22. Unit count: 196 (portal) vs 218 (another portal). Original completion expected 2023; portal now Mar 2026. Freehold premium THB 10,000/sqm (portal), not published. Payment plan on portal for completed project not published. Prices are a mix of developer-stock and resale listings. All figures are advertised/third-party and not confirmed by the developer unless noted. Images added 2026-11-22 from the developer website (https://theonenaiharn.com/). Nearby places refreshed 2026-11-23: beaches, hospitals, big stores (Tesco Lotus, Big C, Makro), markets, schools and kindergartens added from OpenStreetMap as straight-line distances from the FazWaz project coordinates (not road distance). Where a category already had a distance from the developer or a portal, it was kept and not replaced.
